review_scope: Every post-freeze task set, including replacement parent-authored browser tasks, must be independently reviewed against the frozen original capability contract without optimized SKILL.md.
structural_checks: Exactly T1 standard and T2 hard
Self-contained synthetic inputs and observable rubric
No hidden owner or tool execution requirement
No material repetition of historical or optimization pilot scenarios
review_output: One machine-parseable JSON object with accepted, issues and per_task IDs/decisions. Missing or malformed output is not acceptance.
rejections: Retain original fixture and review. Correct only concrete fixture defects in a new revision; do not adjust candidate behavior or safety gates to satisfy a technically invalid rubric.
stop_rule: Stop after two rejected repair passes for diagnosis and owner decision. Do not endlessly retry or replace the judge model.
budget: One sequential caller; check recorded usage and partial calls before each new call. All reviews, failures and retries count against 50,000,000 recorded tokens.
freeze: Hash fixture bytes, review bytes, candidate manifest and original contract. Use only accepted frozen sets for execution; separately disclose advisory gaps.
full_directory_acceptance: 154 Skills require current post-freeze evidence. Pilot regression coverage alone is insufficient. Raw losses and inherited fixture conflicts remain visible in final report.
